interaction_scope: interaction analysis not performed: selected source references exceed 2,000,000 rows; raise --max-reference-rows or reduce --detail-pairs explicitly
episode_link_scope: selected detail pairs; unambiguous city mapping; endpoint relay times; no causal attribution or city-wide contribution denominator
null_scope: exploratory because selection used observed synchrony; no multiplicity-adjusted inference
coverage_scope: full chains row count from metadata; cleaning and activity metrics restricted to candidate endpoints
